newsitem.title: USA: Culligan to buy Ametek unit for $155 million.
newsitem.headline: Culligan to buy Ametek unit for $155 million.

text.p: Culligan Water Technologies Inc., the maker of water purification and treatment products, said Wednesday it entered an agreement to acquire the water filtration business of Ametek Inc. for $155 million.
The purchase price would be payable in Culligan common stock, valued at a fixed price of $37.50 per share, it said.
Ametek will merge with a unit of Culligan following Ametek's spin-off of its non-water filtration operations, Culligan said.
Ametek's water filtration business makes water filtration and treatment products under the brand names Ametek, Plymouth and American Plumber.
Culligan's stock jumped $1.75 to $38.125 while Ametek was up 50 cents at $21.625 on the New York Stock Exchange.
